translations.web: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”
translations.bsb: “Go home,” the king said to the woman, “and I will give orders on your behalf.”
translations.kjv: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
